verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at arize.com/llms.txt and a Markdown rendering of the Phoenix docs (phoenix.md) that points agents to a full documentation index. A Phoenix-scoped llms.txt at /docs/phoenix/llms.txt is also served, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. The MCP server and the agent-driven CLI setup are separate capabilities and are not credited here. missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, no independent community corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
